title: Love the Look!
text: Love the Look!. My daughter is moving into an unfurnished apartment this summer. This chair will be used at her desk. It doesn't have wheels like a lot of desk chairs, but it does swivel which is a good compromise. The chair looks pretty much like the pictures. The directions were easy enough to follow, but it did take a little while to assemble it. My husband did have some difficulties lining up one of the pre-drilled holes, but he made it work. The finished chair looks great! It definitely has a retro vibe to it.
